qualifications: SISC contribution remains published at USD 250,000 for a principal or family up to four. Mandatory biometrics apply to new applications from 14 April 2026. Residency-reform announcements do not establish a universal current stay-day rule.
Standard biometric fees are counted. A 10% discount requires qualifying bookings AND enrolment by 31 December 2026 and is not assumed. Agent, document and any unlisted charges remain extra.
